verdict.rationale: Box's collaborations API documents role-based access control at the file/folder level, akin to ACLs, and community feedback confirms selective granting of folder/file access to outside parties. However, the evidence never enumerates specific roles (viewer/commenter/editor/owner) or explains inheritance behavior between folders and files. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the full role hierarchy and how permissions inherit/cascade from folder to file level.
